title: Science Mom's Guide to Water, Part 6 - Universal Solvent
description:
Learn why things dissolve and why with six hands-on activities: salt crystals, halocline eggs, eggshell geodes, borax snowflakes, rock candy, and bath bombs.

To download your free foldable book with instructions for the activities in this video, go to: https://science.mom/science-mom-s-guide-to-water-part-6

At this link you'll also find additional pictures and tips for how to grow crystals and make bath bombs at home.
